basic_profile.bio: Hi, I'm Alex, a 23-year-old gaming enthusiast from Portland, Oregon. I recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science and am currently working as a junior software developer. In my spare time, I love experimenting with game mods, especially for puzzle games like Baba Is You. I'm also a big fan of talk shows, particularly Howard Stern. When I'm not online, you can find me at local gaming meetups or exploring new hiking trails. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during the weekends. Currently single and loving the freedom to focus on my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a solid foundation in programming from my university education, focusing on game development. I am mostly self-taught when it comes to modding, learning through online tutorials and community forums. My interest in gaming and problem-solving naturally led me to explore modding communities.
